subject: Announcement timeline & QBR asks — proposed Platform reliability lead changes
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Announcement timeline & QBR asks — proposed Platform reliability lead changes

Team —

I’m circulating a draft plan and timeline for communicating the Platform Reliability leadership change we discussed in last week’s strategy sync. High level: we propose announcing internally on Mon 6/12, followed by a customer-facing note to priority accounts on Tue 6/13 during our QBR outreach window.

Why now: we’ve validated the role alignment (serving runtime + infra reliability) and want to lock the org chart before Q3 OKR finalization.

Asks:
- Please review the attached draft_announcement_v2.docx for tone and key messages. I tried to emphasize continuity for customers and clear owner for reliability OKRs.
- Confirm whether we should include a short FAQ (1 pager) for CS/Support.
- Can the comms be ready for exec review by Thurs 6/8 EOD?

Notes for QBR:
- Include a single slide that calls out the leadership change and how it ties to the Reliability OKRs (latency, SLO attainment, incident MTTR).
- Request: Marissa, can you slot 3 minutes in the QBR agenda for a one-slide readout? Laura, we’ll need a short talking script for the exec email.

Attachments: draft_announcement_v2.docx, org_chart_Q3.png, QBR_agenda.pdf

Thanks —
Rafa
Rafael Mendes
VP, Customer Solutions (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Announcement timeline & QBR asks — proposed Platform reliability lead changes

Thanks Rafa — quick read through. A few edits inline:

- Lead with the customer impact sentence (shorter) — customers care about continuity, then mention the role change.
- Suggest we avoid job-title-heavy language in the first external note; use 'Platform reliability lead' rather than 'VP' for the customer email.
- Add an opt-out link for partners who want a private briefing.

I attached a one-page FAQ draft (see QBR_agenda.pdf — I dropped the FAQ on page 3) and a trimmed org_chart_Q3.png (lighter labels).

One more ask: for the QBR slide, please include the OKR success criteria (specific numbers for latency and CPU cost reduction) — that will help Sales and CS field questions.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Announcement timeline & QBR asks — proposed Platform reliability lead changes

Rafael —

Thanks for the draft. I made inline edits to the announcement to emphasize three customer-facing commitments: 1) no immediate changes to SLAs, 2) a named contact for escalation, and 3) a short timeline for the first reliability review meeting (within 30 days).

A few suggestions:
- Move the 'what changes' section below the 'why' paragraph to reduce perceived disruption.
- For the internal note, include a bullet about headcount or team changes only if finalized — otherwise leave it vague.
- We should prep a short boilerplate for account executives to include in QBR invites to priority customers (1-2 lines).

I attached an edited announcement and a sample AE blurb in the QBR_agenda.pdf file.

Cc: ops-comm@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2028 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Announcement timeline & QBR asks — proposed Platform reliability lead changes

All —

This looks good, and I support the proposed timeline with two small edits:
1) Move the internal leadership announcement to Fri 6/9 (end-of-day) rather than Mon 6/12 — gives us time to align managers and update the intranet page.
2) Send the external customer note on Tue 6/13 as planned but limit the initial outreach to our top 20 accounts; we can broaden on Wed 6/14.

Next steps (action owners):
- Rafael: finalize announcement doc with Jonas/Marissa edits and share final for Exec review by Thurs 6/8 morning.
- Marissa: finalize the 1-slide QBR readout and the AE blurb by Tues 6/6.
- Jonas: assemble the 1-pager FAQ and an updated org_chart_Q3.png with clear reporting lines by Wed 6/7.
- Ops-comm: please prepare manager talking points and intranet copy once you receive the final doc.

Also, we should run the external text by Legal for a quick check (I’ll loop them after Exec review).
